names.note: Read out of the life’s heading «Святитель Фотий, митрополит Киевский и всея Руси».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Ιουλίου, «Άγιος Φώτιος Μητροπολίτης Μόσχας», with the rank word and the see left off.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru’s life: died on the feast of the Placing of the Robe of the Theotokos, «2 июля 1431 года».

feast.note: He is also kept on the Julian 5 October with the synaxis of the hierarchs of Moscow, «(Моск. Свт.)», as the fifth of its seventeen names, read on 2026-10-04 from days.pravoslavie.ru's own page for that day. One row per church is the schema, so the synaxis is recorded here and he does not render on it. Its index lists five days for him in all, including «10 октября (Волын.)», a Volhynian commemoration.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 16 сентября ст. ст. — «Свт. Фотия , митр. Киевского, Московского и всея Руси, чудотворца (1431)»

attestations.note: Not on doxologia.ro’s lists for 16 septembrie or 29 septembrie (checked 2026-09-17); no other day checked.

feast.note: saint.gr titles him Metropolitan of Moscow, not of Kyiv as his Russian source does, and keeps him on 2 Ιουλίου, while the Russian row above keeps him on 16 September. Two calendars, two days, and the Greek page is the one quoted here (1 October 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ας Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Φώτιος Μητροπολίτης Μόσχας (; - 1431)»

attestations.note: Not in the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for 29.09.2026 (16. септембар ст. ст.) (checked 2026-09-17); no other day checked.
